definitions.explanation: To propel something through the air with a motion of the arm.
To throw a ball to a batter in baseball.
To stop trying or caring about something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{速|はや}い{球|たま}を{投|な}げる。
{途中|とちゅう}で{投|な}げ{出|だ}した。
examples.notes: {投|な}げ{出|だ}す = to give up, abandon

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{公園|こうえん}でボールを{投|な}げて{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing catch in the park.

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}を{投|な}げかけたけど、{誰|だれ}も{答|こた}えてくれなかった。
examples.english: I posed a question, but no one answered.
examples.notes: 投げかける = to pose (a question)

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{投|な}げる (throw X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {投|な}げている = 'is throwing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ボールを{投|な}げる (throw a ball)
・{石|いし}を{投|な}げる (throw a stone)
・{質問|しつもん}を{投|な}げかける (pose a question)
・{投|な}げ{出|だ}す (give up, abandon)
・{身|み}を{投|な}げる (throw oneself—dramatic)

BASEBALL TERMS:
・{投手|とうしゅ} (pitcher)
・{投球|とうきゅう} (pitching)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
・{投|な}げやり (half-hearted, apathetic—adjective)
